correctness.rationale: Two exhaustive parametrizations of binary three-spaces justify 11811 candidates and 127 zeros, all in the scalar orbit of E0=span(1,t,t^3). The quotient set R of 42 distinct multiplicative ratios of its seven nonzero seed points gives a 42-regular cyclic Cayley graph, and common neighbors between E0,sE0 are exactly |R intersect sR|. An independently written direct 127x127 vertex intersection graph reconstructed all 8001 pair counts: adjacent c=15 (1778) and 21 (889); nonadjacent c=8 (889),10 (889),12 (1778),14 (889),16 (889). It obtained 15113 triangles via edge-codegrees. Exhaustion and exact bit-field arithmetic establish the finite statement, not a sample.
